faq.question: Is there parking at Hauz Khas?
faq.answer: Hauz Khas Village has paid public parking at the village entrance, about a 3-minute walk away. We don't offer valet at Hauz Khas.

faq.question: Is there parking at Golf Course Road?
faq.answer: Golf Course Road has free valet parking from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Do you serve alcohol at Golf Course Road?
faq.answer: Yes. Golf Course Road has a licensed bar serving beer, wine and cocktails. Guests must be of legal drinking age and may be asked for ID.

faq.question: Do you serve alcohol at Hauz Khas?
faq.answer: Hauz Khas is not licensed to serve alcohol, and outside alcohol isn't allowed.

faq.question: Are children welcome?
faq.answer: Yes. High chairs are available, and the kitchen can make child-sized portions of dal, rice and naan on request.

faq.question: Can I bring my dog?
faq.answer: Well-behaved dogs are welcome on the Golf Course Road terrace. Only assistance animals are allowed indoors at either branch.

faq.question: Is there a dress code?
faq.answer: No formal dress code. Most guests dress smart casual.

faq.question: Is Hauz Khas wheelchair accessible?
faq.answer: The Hauz Khas dining room is on the first floor and reached by stairs only. For step-free dining, we recommend Golf Course Road.

faq.question: Is Golf Course Road wheelchair accessible?
faq.answer: Yes. Golf Course Road has a step-free entrance and an accessible washroom.

faq.question: Can you seat a large group?
faq.answer: Online bookings are for 1 to 8 guests. For 9 or more, please call the branch and we'll arrange seating and a set menu.

faq.question: How do I change or cancel my booking?
faq.answer: Please call the branch to change or cancel a booking. There is no cancellation fee.

faq.question: What if I'm running late?
faq.answer: We hold your table for 15 minutes after the booking time. Call the branch if you'll be later than that.

faq.question: How long can we keep the table?
faq.answer: Tables are booked for 90 minutes for 1 to 4 guests and 2 hours for 5 to 8 guests.

faq.question: Can I bring a cake?
faq.answer: Yes, you can bring a celebration cake. There is a ₹300 cakeage charge per cake. Mention it in the booking note.

faq.question: Can you handle food allergies?
faq.answer: Tell your server about any allergy. Our kitchen handles nuts, dairy, gluten and shellfish, so we can't guarantee any dish is free of traces.

faq.question: Do you have vegan options?
faq.answer: Yes. Dishes marked vegan contain no dairy, egg or honey, and there are vegan choices in every section of the menu.

faq.question: Do you serve Jain food?
faq.answer: Dishes marked Jain-available can be made without onion, garlic or root vegetables. Please ask your server when ordering.

faq.question: How can I pay?
faq.answer: We accept cards, UPI and cash.

faq.question: Do you add a service charge?
faq.answer: No service charge is added to the bill. Tipping is optional.

faq.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are welcome when a table is free. We recommend booking for Friday and Saturday dinner.

faq.question: How far ahead can I book?
faq.answer: You can book up to 30 days ahead, and at least 60 minutes before your arrival time.

faq.question: Do you have outdoor seating?
faq.answer: Golf Course Road has a covered terrace; ask for it in the booking note and we'll try to seat you there. Hauz Khas has indoor seating only.

faq.question: Do you have a private dining room?
faq.answer: Golf Course Road has a private room for up to 16 guests. Please call the branch to arrange it.

faq.question: Do you have Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available at both branches. Ask your server for the password.

faq.question: Do I need to pay a deposit to book?
faq.answer: No. Bookings need no deposit and no card.
